[
  {
    "title": "TCS AGENTIC - Positive Testing: Validate Successful LTE Attach and Detach for Multiple UEs",
    "description": "Verify that multiple UEs can successfully attach and detach from a LTE cell under excellent radio conditions following 3GPP TS 23.401 attach and detach procedures.",
    "preconditions": [
      "Network setup is a single isolated LTE cell with excellent radio conditions (LTE RSRP) as per Clause 4.6.",
      "At least 2 stationary UEs (real or emulated) are available.",
      "All other cells are powered off.",
      "Test configuration parameters are recorded."
    ],
    "testSteps": [
      "Configure the test setup according to the test configuration.",
      "Activate and unload the serving LTE cell under test.",
      "Place multiple UEs under excellent LTE radio conditions near the cell center.",
      "Start logging call flow and signalling messages.",
      "Power ON all UEs to initiate LTE Attach procedure.",
      "Wait for each UE to successfully complete the attach procedure (validate Attach Request and Attach Complete messages in logs).",
      "Power OFF all UEs to initiate LTE Detach procedure.",
      "Wait for each UE to successfully complete the detach procedure (validate Detach Request and Detach Accept messages, UE context release, and RRC connection release in logs).",
      "Stop and save test logs.",
      "Repeat the above attach-detach cycle for 10 iterations."
    ],
    "expectedResults": [
      "All UEs attach and detach successfully in all 10 iterations with 100% success rate.",
      "Attach latency measurements (min, average, max) recorded and within expected targets.",
      "No connectivity issues during the test.",
      "Logs confirm correct cell attachment (PCI, Global eNB ID, ARFCN)."
    ],
    "postconditions": [
      "Test logs and KPIs are saved and documented.",
      "Attach and detach success rates and latency KPIs recorded in test report."
    ],
    "commandsUsed": [],
    "verificationMethods": [
      "Check logs for Attach Request and Attach Complete messages for each UE.",
      "Check logs for Detach Request, Detach Accept, UE context release, and RRC connection release messages.",
      "Verify UE's logged cell parameters match test configuration."
    ]
  },
